Subject: Prototype packaging question + short extension ask

Hi Karthik —

Quick follow from our demo yesterday. SparrowTech loved the throughput and the latency profile, but engineering wants clearer guardrails for the 30-day prototype so we can commit internal hours. Two things we need your help on:

1) If we extend the POC by ~3 weeks, can you propose a simple pricing construct that avoids per-token surprise charges? We care about predictability during the integration sprint.
2) We want an option to guarantee burst capacity for demo days (two half-days) without switching to a full Dedicated pool.

Also, who on your side owns billing amendments? We may need a short PO and an amendment to the trial Addendum.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call.

Best,

Director of ML Platforms, SparrowTech
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Prototype packaging question + short extension ask

Hi Alice —

Thanks — glad the demo landed. Quick proposal below that balances predictability with runway for spikes. Draft attached (redwood-prototype-pricing-proposal.pdf). Two lightweight options we commonly use:

Option A — Velocity Pack (predictable, token-based bucket)
- 30-day prototype baseline: 450k input+output tokens included.
- 3-week extension add-on: 180k tokens for $4,500 (prepaid).
- Burst guard: add a refundable reserve of $2,000 to guarantee 2x burst capacity for two half-days (consumed against the reserve).
- Overage: billed at $0.015/1k tokens after reserve is exhausted.

Option B — FairShare Runway (flat timebox + surge credit)
- Purchase additional 21 calendar days for a flat fee of $7,750. Includes an implicit 30% discount vs on-demand during that window.
- Includes 1 engineering support check-in and priority routing for demo-day burst (no additional reserve).
- Overage handled as a capped surge charge (max $1,200).

Notes: both options keep the existing privacy/telemetry terms intact. If you prefer fully deterministic spend, Option B is simpler since it avoids per-token tracking for your accounting team.

Next steps I propose: pick A or B, confirm PO amount, and we’ll issue an amendment with a 1-page billing schedule. I’ve looped in Marissa (commercial) and David (ops) for any follow-ups on billing and capacity.

Attached: redwood-prototype-pricing-proposal.pdf (line-item breakdown), usage-estimate-sparrowtech.xlsx

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
